verdict.rationale: Make's docs confirm webhook-based triggers ('create a url... to trigger the execution of' a scenario) and scheduling for processing events, plus generic app 'Connections' as a core component, supporting event-driven automation from connected apps. However, the evidence pack lacks explicit first-party documentation of specific app trigger types (new record, new message, new email, form submission) beyond generic webhooks/connections, missing for 10: named app-specific trigger modules (e.g., Gmail/Forms/CRM triggers), independent hands-on confirmation of these triggers firing scenarios.
